description: She wears a burgundy floor-length gown with an ivory centre panel, low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, richly edged with gold geometric and floral embroidery. A decorated belt with red jewelled clasp secures the waist; a matching burgundy wrap rests on her forearms. Small rings and burgundy-gold embroidered shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
